status: Uncommitted working research with scoped independent local review.

model_and_readouts.scope: Held radii at the same intake; no equation for flow work or driven mode loading. Trapping, occupation diagnostics, the local triangle and the global angular model are independent comparisons. An orbital dipole of the scalar cavity is not identified with either of the proposed internal states, and the open-well mode counts are not used as mode counts for the angular lattice.
model_and_readouts.confinement: Hard or finite spherical side, common Dirichlet mouth at z=0. The separable comparison has a reflecting end at z=L in both radial regions. In the finite side radial solution j_l(x) is matched to k_l(y), x^2+y^2=R^2(mu_out^2-mu_in^2)/c^2. We retain omega<mu_out, stricter than the guided continuum. The distinct open well has finite gap in B^3(R) x (0,L), exterior gap everywhere else in the half-space, and essential spectrum from mu_out^2. Continuous product trial functions extend into exterior in both directions; exact rational evaluations give upper bounds. The coordinates and inputs are the archived numerical parameters. This does not measure damping or lifetime of a driven, dissipative real drain. Angular matching derivatives: https://dlmf.nist.gov/10.51.
model_and_readouts.open_count: Adding a free Neumann cut across z=L enlarges the form domain; the direct-sum exterior half-space cannot have spectrum below mu_out^2. In the remaining DN cylinder the first axial overtone is above threshold. At .9R0 and R0 the maximum interior radial phase at threshold is below 4.49. The l=2 first binding threshold is the first positive j1 root above 4.49; increasing l increases the potential. The second radial monopole starts at 3pi/2; comparison in l excludes higher radial overtones in all partial waves. Separated upper counts and the full open exact trial bounds together give exactly one l=0 radial/axial multiplet and one l=1 multiplet (three m values). Frequency upper bounds from the open trial are not exact eigenvalues.
model_and_readouts.load_inference: The force matrix columns are (-partial_R omega_b,-partial_L omega_b) at independent geometry and fixed action. For the finite radial step minus partial_R(omega_b^2)=(mu_out^2-mu_in^2)|u_b(R)|^2 for radial unit L2 norm using u=r f. Two measured wave-only loads can invert a nonsingular two-column matrix after removal of other stresses. The reported inverse exercise uses synthetic loads with known 0.7,0.3. At doubled radius explicit positive action triples give the same two loads. Two independently calibrated in-plane dipole traction components resolve 2 Im(a_x* a_y) at a common dipole frequency after subtraction of the uniform component; a third axis would be needed for general spatial angular momentum. These are spatial harmonics rather than internal helicities. Occupations in an actual drain are unknown.
model_and_readouts.triangle: Positive linear reciprocal oscillator with four real coordinates per site. Local alignment operator is the realification of p dot sigma. Free link transports the doublet by an orthogonal rotation. The proposed law is distinct from the native scalar wave. In a marked triangle imposing opposite clamped loop phases F,-F changes the 12-mode sum of omega^12 by 96 J_s^3 t_s^3 det(p0,p1,p2)sin(F); t_s and J_s are squared-frequency coupling scales (alpha*t and alpha*J in the script). All lower squared-frequency moment differences vanish. The independent scalar/copy controls are even; spectrum does not give mode population. Positivity and separate spectroscopy of single patch and pair are demonstrated. This is a local material test; a phase applied on one triangle is not the net flux through a closed surface. At a hard mouth displacement node a direct displacement contact would vanish; an actual coupling requires material support with finite amplitude or a strain-dependent contact.
model_and_readouts.whole_rim: Two distinct triangulated networks with 128 or 512 triangles. Seven previously tested nested cuts. The new global oscillator assumes the six-encounter material polarization profile on the inner cut. Lattice sites have a complex doublet (four real coordinates), standard positive kinetic term, and dynamical matrix D_A=Omega_c^2 I+tau L_A+delta diag(I-p_i dot sigma). L_A is the degree-minus-phased-adjacency graph Laplacian. Omega_c^2=mu_in^2+(c*pi/R)^2+(c*pi/(2L))^2 is supplied as the common background frequency from the hard branch. The soft and open tests are separate. Coefficients chosen for this material hypothesis, not fitted to charge: tau=.04/s^2, delta=.16, s=R/R0. Rb=16s, exterior C=1. Each finite lattice carries its own fixed springs, so cross-lattice agreement is not a continuum limit.
model_and_readouts.comparison: The axial component of every squared frequency is (v_z/L)^2 with v_z=c*pi/2. In the untwisted preparation F_L=(v_z^2/L^3) sum I_b/omega_b. For each held R set the axial benchmark equal to the conservative axial wall+volume balance 4pi sigma R^2+(4pi/3)alpha_volume R^3. No curvature contribution, no free-radius equilibrium assumed; the real drain's wave-only load is unmeasured. Compare against the untwisted neutral trial with the same fixed nonnegative actions on ordered frequency ranks. This covers arbitrary mixtures, not active reloading, rank-permuting continuations, discontinuous mode transfer or additional work by the inflow. A nonzero exterior unit costs at least pi/(2Rb) for E=(1/2)integral |B|^2 with flux 2pi on a source-free exterior.
model_and_readouts.ground_bound: A spinor trial in the flat rim and a scalar comparison using the norm at each site bound the lowest squared frequency on opposite sides. If lambda_0(0)<=U and lambda_0(A)>=B, Omega_c^2 omitted from both, the maximal release per F_L is at most (U-B)omega_high/[(omega_high+omega_low)v_z^2/L^3]. Comparison covers any free links, both mirrors and both finite lattices.
model_and_readouts.all_rank_bounds: Deleting positive springs to either of two spanning trees bounds every ordered frequency by the corresponding tree spectral line from below. All phases can be removed by site rephasing on each tree while preserving the signed onsite mixing. For each rank take the larger lower bound and an upper bound from the full untwisted network. The sorted eigenvalue enclosure uses a rounded dyadic Hermitian matrix and rounded candidate eigenvectors Q and eigenvalues V. Exact integer products bound g=||Q*Q-I|| and r=||H Q-QV||. With U the unitary polar factor, ||U-Q||<=g for g<1. Every sorted eigenvalue is certified within r+(||H||+||V||)g plus the material rounding bound. Independent floor La>=0 and face identity for L0 give D0<=Da+9tau I. The maximum wave release per unit F_L is bounded above by the maximum over ranks of omega_upper(omega_upper-omega_lower)/(v_z^2/L^3); apply only to occupied bound ranks at flat preparation. Antipodal site permutation takes the prepared plus mouth to its minus partner, and all possible fields are included. Realification doubles multiplicity, leaving the bound unchanged.
model_and_readouts.collar: For nonzero net exterior flux, any compact half-turn face costs Kmin W(pi), any charged prism at least 5Kmin W(2pi/5), and with neither present all seven cuts have the same nonzero degree. Jensen then costs >=7 NF Kmin W(2pi/NF), W=8sin^2(F/8); take the smallest of these three costs in addition to the exterior. At s=2 both lattices exclude a unit if all compact loop springs exceed 0.354000 in common units. The explicit law K=1/s is the previous unit spring at the reference radius, scaled to match the 1/R energy of a homothetic fixed-flux field; it is an added constitutive assumption for large twists. For the five smaller sample radii the exterior cost alone exceeds the wave release. If K were negligible at doubled radius the available bounds allow the unit only with at least 0.671870 of the axial wave load in excited ranks across the two tests; this is necessary, not sufficient. No equilibrium formation, unique physical electric unit, probe force or translation balance is implied.

import yaml
from mpmath import iv
iv.dps = 50
v = iv.mpf
data = yaml.load(Path("software/stage1_solver/reports/pathA_26_derrick_results.yaml").read_bytes(), Loader=yaml.BaseLoader)
r0, length = map(v, data["phase_A"]["q_star"])
speed, mi, mo = (v(data["parameters"][k]) for k in ("c_w", "mu_in", "mu_out"))
pi = iv.pi
def enclosure(x):
    scale = 10**9
    a, b = int((x*scale).a), int((x*scale).b)+1
    return f"[{a//scale}.{a%scale:09d},{b//scale}.{b%scale:09d}]"
z1 = 3*pi*speed/(2*length)
x0 = v("4.49")
s2 = iv.sin(x0)-x0*iv.cos(x0)
second_monopole_threshold = 3*pi/2
print("j=1 axial frequency",enclosure(z1),"squared cutoff margin mi^2+kz^2-mo^2",enclosure(mi**2+z1**2-mo**2))
print("j1 first-root test at 4.49: interval for sin(x)-x*cos(x)",enclosure(s2),"radial n=2 monopole onset",enclosure(second_monopole_threshold))
results = [mi**2+z1**2>mo**2, pi<x0, x0<3*pi/2, s2>0]
for ratio in (".9","1"):
    xcut = v(ratio)*r0*iv.sqrt(mo**2-mi**2-(pi*speed/(2*length))**2)/speed
    print("ratio",ratio,"maximum allowable inside radial phase at continuum",enclosure(xcut),"first l=2 radial phase lower 4.49","first n=2 lower",enclosure(second_monopole_threshold))
    results.extend((xcut<x0,xcut<second_monopole_threshold))
assert all(results)
print("all sufficient inequalities", [bool(k) for k in results])'

local_reviews.verdict: Scoped clear for the exact open-well monopole and dipole counts at 0.9R₀ and R₀, the synthetic two-load occupation inference, and the exterior-unit exclusion on both tested rims at all six sampled radii under the stated spring law, axial support load, and fixed frequency-ranked actions. The largest-radius exclusion uses the seven-shell field energy. The physical coupling to an electric probe and the 0PN free-fall balance remain open.
local_reviews.disposition: Checked the square-well radial and axial forms and independently ran the Neumann comparison. Strengthened the arbitrary-occupation bounds using spanning-tree spectra, retained sorted-action and wave-only-load qualifications, linked the earlier hard-wall root, and specified that the preferred flux sign reverses on the mirror.

local_reviews.role: Read-only independent audit of native wave and archive assumptions. The standing scalar provides resonance frequencies, while signed rim mixing, physical link, mode occupations and their load transfer are unspecified. No formal acceptance verdict.
